content: अच्छिन्न [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Uninterrupted, continuous, constant; ˚शिवसंकल्पमन्तःकरणमस्तु ते <ls>Mv. 4. 36</ls> undisturbed in its holy thoughts, ever cherishing holy thoughts; ˚अमलसन्तानाः सरितः कीर्तयश्च ते <ls>Ku. 6. 69</ls>. .²2 Not cut or divided, undivided, uninjured; inseparable.
